senses.gloss: m.(b. h. מָבוֹא; בּוֹא)entrance, gate, esp. entrance to a group of buildings, alley, lane.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 1:1">Erub. I, 1</cite> <he>מ׳ שהוא גבוה וכ׳</he> an entrance the joist over which lies higher than &c.
<cite ref="Eruvin 8b:4">Ib. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ העשוי כנדל</he> an alley formed like a polyp (with side entrances beside the main gateway).
<cite ref="Tosefta Eiruvin 1:2">Tosef. ib. I, 2</cite> <he>מ׳ שיש לו צורת פתח</he> an alley which has the shape of a gate (archway); a. fr.—Pl. <he>מְבוֹאוֹת</he> (fem.).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 21b:9">B. Bath. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>בני מ׳</he> inmates of the same alley. Y. Ber. II, 4ᵇ top <he>מ׳ המטונפות</he> filthy alleys; a. fr.
